breakdown.description: Normal shock waves only form in supersonic flow
breakdown.reason: The generated specification corrected the upstream Mach number from 0.8 (subsonic, physically impossible for a normal shock) to M1 = 2.0 (supersonic), matching the ground truth.

breakdown.description: Second law of thermodynamics prohibits expansion shocks (subsonic to supersonic transitions via shock)
breakdown.reason: By using M1 = 2.0 (supersonic), the generated specification ensures the normal shock is a compression shock (supersonic to subsonic), which is consistent with the second law of thermodynamics. The physically impossible expansion shock scenario implied by M = 0.8 is eliminated.
